verdict.rationale: Maritime documents fleet-style provisioning: each end user gets their own agent micro-VM via an idempotent SDK `provision` call (maritime-docs-18, maritime-docs-45, maritime-docs-37). The only documented limits are plan-based agent counts, such as 3 agents on the free plan and a set number of agents per subscription with paid extras (maritime-docs-20, maritime-docs-27). Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits (simultaneous running VMs, rate limits, per-account caps beyond plan seat counts), evidence of large-scale concurrent operation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet performance.
